gaps.acceptance: Policy receives IDs and revealed feedback; trusted gateway returns winner/confidence/validity for requested pairs, meters unique newly revealed pairs, cache reads and attempts, and supplies an external stop at budget. Independent evaluator holds utilities and labels.

gaps.observed: Current plan proposes random, coverage and active allocation with fixed judge/R7; concrete interactive protocol remains pending.
gaps.acceptance: Use same pools, seeds, per-pool budgets and total tuning opportunity. Coverage-random and coverage-active share the same initial edge sequence. Report task-macro regret, tie-aware best-hit, graph coverage, failures and budgets. Freeze policy before final evaluation. Saved judgments support first-reveal replay, not fresh stochastic re-queries.

gaps.observed: Official source inspected; local task adapter and experiment-only runner remain future work. Existing R7 historical runner checks clean Git and archive/registration hashes, so it is not a direct mutable-template entry point.
gaps.acceptance: Pin upstream revision and isolate its environment; reuse pure selection/scoring functions in a small adapter. Agent edits proposed allocation policy and plots; trusted harness/evaluator and baseline remain outside its writable mount. Keep held-out data and evaluation-only archives outside its readable mount. Validate saved results independently. Enforce aggregate runtime, model-request/token/cost and repair-attempt caps outside prompts; preserve failure logs and full changed-code snapshots. Preflight AI Scientist model client and Aider coder separately with controlled mock responses before budgeted calls.

Failure and timeout branches remove the run output folder; preserve raw failure artifacts outside that folder before adopting the loop.
Full launch continues into writeup/review; first integration should call the experiment loop through a small dedicated entry point.
Model client and Aider coding model use separate construction paths; ForeAgent endpoint preflight covers a different integration.
